newsitem.title: USA: PECO Limerick Pa. nuke output at 76 percent.
newsitem.headline: PECO Limerick Pa. nuke output at 76 percent.

text.p: PECO Energy Co's 1,055 megawatt Limerick nuclear power unit 2 boosted output to 76 percent of capacity as of early Thursday following a reduction for repairs, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
The unit, located in Pottsdam, Pa., reduced power output to 40 percent of capacity Wednesday due to a valve problem.
Power output was expected to peak at about 76 percent of capacity on Thursday as the unit continued to coast down to a 25-day maintenance and refueling outage set to begin Jan 31.
The adjacent 1,055 megawatt Limerick unit 1 continued to operate normally at full power as of early Thursday, the NRC said.
